breaks.Affected_Buyer_or_Use_Case: Large enterprise transformation, complex regulated operations, workflow-heavy service environments
breaks.Break_Summary: Unified-stack simplicity breaks under bespoke enterprise orchestration
breaks.Build_or_Config_Implication: Explicit control-plane map, integration boundaries, failure ownership and tested degraded mode.
breaks.Buyer_Question: Which system is authoritative for long-running work state, and can 8x8 fail without corrupting that state?
breaks.Change_Consequence: Every new workflow/model/integration increases regression scope.
breaks.Cost_Consequence: Higher integration, testing and regression cost.
breaks.Day2_Consequence: Simplification advantage erodes and support becomes cross-platform.
breaks.Exit_Point: Select a separate orchestration/state platform or another CCaaS architecture if 8x8 would become the de facto enterprise process engine.
breaks.Mitigation_Method: Keep system-of-record/process-state authority in CRM/BPM/orchestration; use 8x8 for communications/routing where rational.
breaks.Trigger_Condition: Buyer selects 8x8 primarily for UC+CC simplification, then adds long-running process state, extensive bespoke integrations, multiple AI control planes and enterprise-wide orchestration requirements.

breaks.Affected_Buyer_or_Use_Case: Workforce-heavy contact centers, enterprise WFM transformation
breaks.Break_Summary: WEM architecture choice creates support and ownership fragmentation
breaks.Build_or_Config_Implication: Name exact WFM/QM products/SKUs and runtime support RACI.
breaks.Buyer_Question: Which WFM product actually owns forecasting, schedules, adherence and employee self-service in this deal?
breaks.Change_Consequence: Future WFM feature or vendor changes can trigger re-integration/retraining.
breaks.Cost_Consequence: Potential duplicate licensing, migration and admin labor.
breaks.Day2_Consequence: Multiple admin surfaces and incident boundaries persist.
breaks.Exit_Point: Use native 8x8 WFM only when it meets workload complexity; otherwise accept/contract the partner control plane explicitly.
breaks.Mitigation_Method: Choose one WFM architecture deliberately; document data, admin, support and commercial boundaries.
breaks.Refresh_Trigger: WFM packaging, partner relationship or native feature change.
breaks.Trigger_Condition: Buyer assumes WEM is one native control plane, but proposed scope mixes native 8x8 WFM/QM with Calabrio or Verint components.

breaks.Affected_Buyer_or_Use_Case: AI-first automation, transactional self-service, agentic workflows
breaks.Break_Summary: AI capability breadth outruns a single mature production control plane
breaks.Build_or_Config_Implication: AI architecture inventory, model/provider map, action permissions, audit, fallback and contract RACI.
breaks.Buyer_Question: Which exact AI product, model/provider and support boundary performs each assist, self-service or action workflow?
breaks.Change_Consequence: Model/provider or GA-status changes can alter economics, data path and risk.
breaks.Cost_Consequence: Integration, licensing, model-governance and fallback cost.
breaks.Day2_Consequence: Multiple AI control/support planes require separate lifecycle management.
breaks.Exit_Point: Constrain AI authority or select a more mature single-control-plane architecture if the buyer cannot govern multiple AI dependencies.
breaks.Mitigation_Method: Separate AI Studio EAP, Smart Assist Limited Availability/Creovai and ICA/Cognigy; gate authority by workflow and production state.
breaks.Refresh_Trigger: AI Studio GA; Smart Assist GA/provider change; ICA/Cognigy relationship change.
breaks.Trigger_Condition: Buyer treats AI Studio, Smart Assist and ICA as one fully native GA agentic stack.

breaks.Break_Summary: Public BPO proof does not establish hard multi-client operating controls
breaks.Build_or_Config_Implication: Client-by-client architecture and billing attribution matrix.
breaks.Buyer_Question: Can one pooled agent serve multiple clients without context/data bleed and with client-level usage attribution?
breaks.Change_Consequence: Adding clients increases blast-radius and attribution complexity.
breaks.Cost_Consequence: Margin leakage, duplicated licenses or client-specific engineering.
breaks.Day2_Consequence: Client governance and chargeback remain manual or fragile if not proven.
breaks.Exit_Point: Eliminate for pooled multi-client programs if isolation/shared-agent/attribution requirements cannot be proven.
breaks.Mitigation_Method: Run a two-client proof lab covering isolation, shared agents, reporting, WEM, integrations and cost attribution.
breaks.Refresh_Trigger: Multi Contact Center/BPO architecture or commercial changes.
breaks.Trigger_Condition: BPO assumes a named customer story and Multi Contact Center admin RBAC prove tenant isolation, pooled-agent switching, client-level WEM/reporting and usage attribution.

breaks.Affected_Buyer_or_Use_Case: Sovereignty-sensitive multinational or high-volume contact centers

breaks.Cost_Consequence: Regional architecture, additional services and capacity engineering cost.
breaks.Day2_Consequence: Ongoing locality and headroom monitoring required.
breaks.Exit_Point: Use another architecture or constrain features when mandatory locality or peak-headroom requirements cannot be proven.
breaks.Mitigation_Method: Map persistent/service/media/AI data paths and run buyer-shaped load/failover tests; contract required limits/regions.
breaks.Trigger_Condition: Regulated or high-scale buyer assumes global media/data-center presence and SLA prove every data/AI path is local and every peak topology has sufficient headroom.

bpo_fit.Client_Specific_Routing: Supported through contact-center configuration; exact client isolation topology must be proven.

bpo_fit.Integration_Isolation: Client-specific credentials, API boundaries and blast radius require architecture proof.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: The simplification thesis creates business value only when overlap actually disappears.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use 8x8 when the buyer materially values one supplier family for UC+CC, global voice and CX operations rather than assembling multiple control planes.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Class fit favors right-sized operating capacity over maximum feature breadth.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use 8x8 when the buyer needs credible omnichannel, WFM and outbound without the transformation gravity of a highly bespoke enterprise program.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Partner and global operating model align to deployment/Day-2 capacity.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use 8x8 when channel carry, global voice, regional operations and packaged integrations are more valuable than custom platform engineering.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Native WFM economics and operational integration can reduce stack complexity.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use 8x8 when buyer wants native WFM integrated with contact center and can avoid a separate workforce license/control plane.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: 'WEM' can hide materially different products, contracts and support surfaces.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use caution if the proposed solution mixes native 8x8 WFM, Calabrio or Verint without an explicit control-plane/support RACI.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Native EAP plus Creovai/Capacity and Cognigy dependencies create different maturity, support and economics.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use caution if AI Studio, Smart Assist and ICA are presented as one homogeneous native AI layer.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Global presence is not equivalent to exact workload locality.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use caution until persistent data, recordings, media, service data, AI processing and subprocessors are mapped by workload and region.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Named BPO proof and admin RBAC do not prove the complete operating model.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Use caution when the buyer needs hard isolation, pooled shared agents and granular client-level attribution.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: The simplification thesis breaks when CCaaS becomes a surrogate BPM/state platform.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Eliminate an 8x8-led architecture for a workload when the buyer requires the CCaaS layer itself to own durable, exception-heavy enterprise process state that cannot be proven rational.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Structural policy requirements cannot be averaged away by channel or feature breadth.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Eliminate the proposed design if contractual client isolation, locality or processing restrictions cannot be satisfied by the exact 8x8/partner components.

decision_intelligence.Causal_Rationale: Low entry complexity does not make a bespoke estate low-complexity on Day 2.
decision_intelligence.Statement: Eliminate an over-customized 8x8 estate if the buyer cannot own APIs, partner WEM/AI, release regression and cross-vendor incident management after go-live.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Model base/peak/growth scenarios including CCaaS, UC dependency, telephony, storage, WEM choice, QM, AI, services and customer labor.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Quote, SKU entitlements, usage units, labor assumptions, sensitivity outputs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Hidden usage/third-party/services costs reverse the business case.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show actual three-year run-state cost for a comparable customer.
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer volumes, quote/SKUs, usage history, staffing model.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Headline unified-stack value is assumed to produce lower three-year TCO.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Three-year TCO remains within buyer threshold under peak and AI-growth scenarios.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Inject regional/SIP/dependency failure across representative voice/digital/CRM paths and measure failover.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Failover timings, lost interactions, state continuity, incident RACI.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Failover saturates, loses state or external dependency creates unacceptable outage.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Describe a real failover and dependency incident, not only SLA credits.
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Approved BCP architecture and test traffic.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: 99.999% platform availability is assumed to equal end-to-end buyer continuity.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Critical services remain within agreed RTO/RPO/quality and capacity headroom.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Map data/media/AI/subprocessors then execute peak/burst/API load in selected region and failure mode.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Signed locality matrix, system limits, test logs, support escalation.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unknown processing location, throttling or saturation violates buyer requirement.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How did the service behave at a comparable regional peak?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Global footprint is assumed to satisfy locality and buyer-shaped capacity.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All mandatory locality rules are met and peak plus failover stays inside proven limits.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Configure two clients with distinct routing, recording, reporting, WEM, integrations and usage; test authorized/unauthorized shared-agent access.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Screens/logs/exports showing isolation, agent context and chargeback.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cross-client leakage, forced duplicated labor model, or unattributable usage.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How are pooled agents and chargeback handled in production?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Two client datasets/policies and staffing model.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: BPO references and admin RBAC are assumed to prove multi-client isolation and economics.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No cross-client data/control leakage; required shared-agent flow works; usage is attributable.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run a long-running exception-heavy workflow with external system outage, retry, duplicate event and delayed human action.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Event/state trace, recovery log, ownership matrix.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Duplicate actions, lost state or unclear system of record requires external orchestration.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which system owns process state when integrations fail?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative process and systems of record.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: 8x8 is assumed to be the right durable process/state owner for every enterprise workflow.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Authoritative state remains consistent; recovery is idempotent and auditable.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Fault-inject token expiration, API throttle, CRM outage and schema change into a key workflow.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Logs, queue/retry behavior, RACI, recovery evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Silent data loss, duplicate write or unclear incident owner.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How are CRM/API incidents isolated and recovered?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Packaged CRM connector/API breadth is assumed to equal operational supportability.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Core service degrades predictably, errors are observable, replay/recovery succeeds.

proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Policy/throughput failure or manual repair required.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show a comparable compliant production campaign.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Current outbound modes are assumed to handle buyer scale/compliance automatically.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Campaign stays within policy, throughput and abandon/quality thresholds.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Compare native 8x8 WFM vs proposed Calabrio/Verint architecture on forecast, schedule, adherence, failure and admin ownership.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Support/admin/data boundary creates unacceptable complexity or missing capability.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which WEM product is live and who supports the boundary?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Historical workload and selected product proposal.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Any 8x8 WEM option is assumed operationally equivalent.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Chosen architecture meets planning accuracy/operability and has clear RACI.

proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Feature matrix, logs, support paths, contractual terms.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: EAP/partner dependency is hidden or support/action boundary is ambiguous.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which AI control plane owned the failure in a real deployment?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: 8x8 AI portfolio is assumed to be one mature native production control plane.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every component has explicit production status, RACI, observability, fallback and economics.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Execute allowed transaction with duplicate trigger, tool timeout, stale context, unauthorized request and rollback scenario.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Tool/action audit, confirmations, error logs, rollback evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unauthorized/duplicate/incomplete action or no safe recovery.

proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Permissions enforced; action completion verified; duplicates prevented; failure escalates/compensates.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Compare human-only vs assisted interactions for accuracy, latency, acceptance, error repair and outage behavior.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Matched results, latency, errors, agent overrides, incident RACI.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Assist is late/wrong/disruptive or support boundary delays recovery.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What measured agent outcome changed in production?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Smart Assist is assumed to improve agents despite Limited Availability and partner control plane.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Net human+AI outcome improves without unsafe over-reliance; fallback works.

proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How is resolution verified beyond bot containment?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: ICA containment is assumed to equal verified resolution.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Backend transaction and customer outcome complete; failure is detected and transferred with context.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Score a calibrated human benchmark set and challenge ambiguous/noncompliant interactions.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Confusion matrix, calibration, appeal outcomes, audit logs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Systematic bias/error or unverifiable rationale affects downstream decisions.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How is human ground truth validated before AI scoring?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Automated evaluation is assumed trustworthy because coverage exists.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Agreement/error distribution meets buyer threshold and appeals/overrides are auditable.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Execute sample export and termination/retention walkthrough for each data class.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Export files, schemas, timing, deletion evidence, fees.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Critical data/config is unavailable, proprietary or only manually recoverable.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What did a recent customer actually export at exit?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Buyer assumes recordings, transcripts, analytics, WFM/QM, AI/configuration and audit data can be cleanly exited.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Required data is exportable in usable documented formats within agreed time/cost.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Have buyer admins perform representative queue, WFM, CRM/API, AI and incident changes after implementation handoff.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Task completion, runbooks, rollback, support escalations.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Routine change requires unexpected SI/vendor dependency or creates regression.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What percentage of customers own these changes without SI help?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Low implementation friction is assumed to mean low Day-2 ownership even after customization.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Buyer can safely execute agreed routine changes and knows escalation boundaries.
